author: Syzyf
quote: Waited 16 years for GTA 6.* You can’t use weapons in gay clubs.* You can’t run over protected minority NPCs.* The female protagonist is an overweight Latina.* You can’t cheat on the overweight Latina.* No prostitutes or cocaine.* The first 6 hours are just doing errands for a boring, whiny Latina.* Every line of dialogue sounds like it was written by liberal feminist girlbosses who hate men.* The male protagonist spends the whole game doing favors for a girl who ghosted him for a year.* The Indian devs left 6 million bugs in the code, including planes randomly falling out of the sky.* The combat system is glitchy and terrible.* The game barely reaches 20 FPS (GTA V ran at 60).* You basically paid $100 just to be a simp and a cuck for a brunette for 200 hours.* This isn’t the GTA it used to be.* The GTA we grew up with is gone.* Then you realize that the fun video games and the cool world you grew up with are never coming back.
